quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce invests 300 million in UK manufacturing and (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce announced a GBP 300 million investment in UK manufacturing and engineering facilities for Civil Aerospace and Defence growth: more than GBP 140 million in Derby (new engineering and manufacturing services facilities, plus aftermarket capacity; works expected to be completed in 2028), over GBP 90 million in Bristol (facility upgrade including more MRO capability; completed in 2031), GBP 43 million at Inchinnan, Glasgow (machinery to manufacture new engine components), GBP 19 million at the Rotherham Advanced Blade Casting Facility (plus GBP 2 million from the South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority) to double its output of advanced turbine blades by 2030, and GBP 5 million at Ansty. Rolls-Royce has invested more than GBP 3 billion in the UK since the start of its transformation programme in 2023 and spent more than GBP 2.8 billion with UK-based suppliers in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: GBP 300 million UK investment; Rotherham turbine blade output doubling by 2030
